register_metadata.notes: The previous PNG core assets and model slide PNGs were rejected by user review on 2026-08-13 as unprofessional/unusable. Unusable PNG output folders images/planned/ and images/model-slides/ were deleted. Model presentation replacements are now editable PPTX decks under revision/assets/model-slide-decks/. Core textbook image assets still require a new approved design workflow before Phase 5 can be closed.

style_lock.diagram_style: Clean flat-vector educational diagram style, muted professional color palette, generous white space, thin consistent line weights, simple geometric icons, textbook-infographic quality. No photographic texture, no gradients, no logos, no watermarks. No readable body text beyond short labels explicitly specified in the prompt.
style_lock.scenario_style: Warm professional flat-vector illustration style, generic non-identifiable figures, predominantly Japanese/East Asian in appearance for Japan-based learner material, professional business-casual attire, muted professional palette, no logos, no watermarks, no brand names, no real national flags, no seals, no emblems, no crests, no country-specific patriotic imagery, no accidental readable text.
style_lock.business_client_visual_rule: Use fictional or sanitized operational visuals only. No real firm names, real bank logos, securities exchange names, stock ticker symbols, customer names, account, shipment, or order numbers, shipment IDs, proprietary UI, securities-market predictions, securities trading recommendations, investment advice, or compliance/legal advice.
style_lock.government_visual_rule: Use plain administrative offices, meeting rooms, counters, forms, workflow diagrams, or service-delivery settings. No real national flags, seals, emblems, crests, official insignia, political campaign symbols, party symbols, or country-specific iconography.
